blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE : Here’s your first trailer for Andrew Haigh ‘s Telluride, Toronto and New York Film Festival drama A Long Winter , starring Fred Hechinger, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Caitriona Balfe, Kit Connor and D’Pharaoh Woon-A-Tai.

Based on Haigh’s adaptation of Colm Tóibín’s short story of the same name, the film is set during the early 1950s in a remote part of the Colorado mountains “as fall comes to an end and a family prepares for the long winter ahead”.

Pic is produced by Tristan Goligher for The Bureau, Chad Oakes and Mike Frislev for Calgary-based Nomadic Pictures, and Michael Elliott. The film, which plays the London Film Festival this evening, was developed by Mubi and is co-financed by Mubi and Film4. Mubi is handling most of the release with the film in cinemas January 15 in the UK and Ireland, January 22 in the U.S. and Canada, and February 18 in Germany, Austria, Italy, Spain and Latin America.

Haigh’s All of Us Strangers received six BAFTA nominations, including best director and best adapted screenplay for Haigh. It was also the recipient of four Gotham and three Independent Spirit Awards nominations. Haigh’s previous features include Film4-backed Lean on Pete and 45 Years , for which Charlotte Rampling earned an Oscar nomination, and breakout indie hit Weekend .
